items.title: How much does the team's trust erode during the wait, depending on how Priya communicates?
items.description: Priya's real situation: a signal has already leaked, and she's committed to a 9-day wait until the Friday check-in. This models how much rumor/speculation fills the gap, based on how many days pass between updates and whether she sends the short 'nothing new yet' message partway through. Drag the days-between-updates slider up to see what happens if she goes silent for the whole wait instead of checking in at the midpoint.

params.name: signalAlreadyLeaked
params.label: Has a signal already leaked (like the calendar invite)?

items.compute: let base = params.daysBetweenUpdates * 9; if (params.signalAlreadyLeaked >= 1) { base = base * 1.6; } let rumorFill = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(base))); return { rumorFill };
